reviews.review:
I rarely give game reviews. Let alone long-ish ones. But after having logged in hours of gameplay on B4B, I am in a better position now to give my thoughts. And yes, from the start I planned on giving my thoughts on this one, because, obviously this game tangents from L4D and L4D2 – games which I and everyone enjoyed thoroughly and up to now still play.

It’s a THUMBS UP for me. Not for reasons of sentimentality.

I can understand why a lot of people do not like it. My first thought – Confusing. Yes lots of mechanics, too busy, tons of stuff going on (what’s with the bloody cards anyways?) – felt like I have to read a thick manual to start enjoying it.

But guess what – START enjoying it – start shooting. Never mind the confusion, never mind the stupid cards, just start the campaign – even on veteran mode – and you’d be fine with what you have initially. The game is very generous. The characters are great (love Hoffman). The story is solid. The guns are Goooooood.

To my thinking, why expect sort of something like L4D and L4D2? Those are classics not meant to be touched anymore. They are perfect the way they are. If B4B went down the same-ish track, then everyone, will utterly, completely rubbish it. B4B would have not evolved.

So, my hat’s off to the developers. Good job. If I gave a thumbs down, it will not be for reasons of game abandonment or some other non-game related reasons. We review primarily for the quality of the game, be it good or bad. And for me, B4B is Good!
it's ok. a far cry from Left 4 Dead 1&2

This game is best when played without comparison to other titles, and to be fair I've enjoyed this with people who I have a great time playing multiplayer with. It isn't something that I would suggest sinking too many hours into at this stage of the game, as most players have moved on from this title from what I hear, but for a try, it's rather fun, and has a cute cast of characters. There isn't too much to the story or dialogue, so it's mostly still an action game with some nice atmosphere. Fast-paced gameplay, and enjoyable as a first person shooter to enjoy casually.

Solo play is also pretty decent, although the best experience is with friends.
